current_sofr.authority: Official NY Fed SOFR is the realized funding-rate authority. SR3 is forward context only.
current_sofr.name: SOFR

recent_funding_views.implication: HOLD the empty book and remain at the zero official-SOFR benchmark. Official NY Fed SOFR 3.85 percent ACT/360 is the realized funding authority; any deployed shocked-risk capital pays that rate and is not financed by the cancelling $100m cash-versus-benchmark SOFR flows. Realized overnight SOFR should stay near the new 3.75-4.00 band (just printed 3.85) and therefore print lower than the 3m-12m SR3 strip (4.315/4.565/4.735), which already embeds subsequent hike odds. That overnight-versus-term gap is not a packet-supported SR3 receive: US inflation 72, labor 75, and a delivered Sep-16 hike make receiving poorly timed, while paying the same strip after +15.0 to +88.5bp versus overnight is priced. Flat cash is the zero benchmark, not alpha.
recent_funding_views.sr3_forward_view: Frozen funding_context forward_summaries only: 1m is null (unsupported). 3m SR3Z6 expiry 2026-12 implied 4.315; 6m SR3H7 expiry 2027-03 implied 4.565; 12m SR3U7 expiry 2027-09 implied 4.735. Adjacent policy_paths SR3U6 2026-09 implied 4.00 versus official overnight SOFR 3.85 (+15.0bp). These are term futures, not the cash fixing.

recent_funding_views.implication: Hold the full undeployed $100m in cash. Official SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 is about $10,694 per calendar day on $100m and is the realized funding authority; deploying stops that yield. Realized overnight SOFR should stay near the new 3.75-4.00 band (just printed 3.85) and therefore print lower than the 3m-12m SR3 strip (4.32/4.58/4.755), which already embeds subsequent hike odds. That overnight-versus-term gap is not a packet-supported SR3 receive: US inflation 72, labor 75, and a delivered Sep-16 hike make receiving poorly timed, while paying the same strip after +15 to +90.5bp versus overnight is priced. Cash compounds at the official fixing without buying or fading a post-event curve.
